hypothesis: Developers building AI agents and LLM applications will adopt Firecrawl when shown concrete proof of open-source transparency, CLI integration patterns, structured LLM-ready data output, and specific workflow capabilities (search, scrape, interact, research, monitor) that solve their web data pipeline burden.

calls.reason: Find past campaign evidence about what specific Firecrawl features and messaging drove developer adoption for AI agent workflows
Identify what AI agent developers actually engage with on Hacker News regarding Firecrawl's web data capabilities
Measure which content types and platforms (X, LinkedIn) historically drove engagement for Firecrawl's developer-focused messaging
Check if past claims about Firecrawl's reliability, speed, and AI agent integration were verified or flagged
Identify specific claims about Firecrawl's capabilities that failed verification to avoid repeating them
Understand previous campaign goals, editorial scores, and fact/claim patterns for Firecrawl developer marketing

sql: SELECT evidence_id, heading, excerpt FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.evidence_section WHERE domain = 'firecrawl.dev' AND (lower(excerpt) LIKE '%open-source web data api%' OR lower(excerpt) LIKE '%cli integration ai agents%' OR lower(excerpt) LIKE '%llm-ready data extraction%' OR lower(excerpt) LIKE '%search scrape interact workflow%' OR lower(excerpt) LIKE '%developer-focused scraping api%') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10

CREATE REST SESSION TABLE fl_hn_live11e31d6e0eaf REQUEST (endpoint "https://hn.algolia.com/api/v1/search?query=firecrawl.dev&tags=story&hitsPerPage=50", method "GET", http_encoding "URLENCODED", response_type "JSON", insecure_ssl "false") HEADER ("User-Agent" "Flusso/0.3 (evidence agent)") BODY ()

SELECT platform, asset_type, count(*) AS assets, sum(impressions) AS impressions, sum(engagements) AS engagements, sum(clicks) AS clicks, sum(conversions) AS conversions FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.performance WHERE domain = 'firecrawl.dev' GROUP BY platform, asset_type ORDER BY engagements DESC

SELECT h.title, h.points, h.num_comments, substr(h.created_at, 1, 10) AS created, h.url FROM session.fl_hn_live11e31d6e0eaf LATERAL VIEW explode(hits) AS h WHERE h.url LIKE '%firecrawl.dev%' ORDER BY h.points DESC LIMIT 12

reason: Find past campaign evidence about what specific Firecrawl features and messaging drove developer adoption for AI agent workflows
note: Search terms: open-source web data api, cli integration ai agents, llm-ready data extraction, search scrape interact workflow, developer-focused scraping api

sql: SELECT o.claim_kind, o.status, count(*) AS claims, sum(CASE WHEN o.resolution_status = 'repaired' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repaired FROM lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.claim_outcome o JOIN lightning.metastore.flusso.brand_evidence.campaign c ON o.campaign_id = c.campaign_id WHERE c.domain = 'firecrawl.dev' GROUP BY o.claim_kind, o.status ORDER BY claims DESC
